results.test: FIX A3 (COMBINED CLOSEOUT R1): functional DOM self-test — nested closed <details> (inner OPEN, outer CLOSED): the descendant control inside the open inner details is still excluded from focus order because the OUTER details is closed, while the outer details' own first <summary> remains focusable
ENV-B2 PART 1/5-7: In-Memory runtime storage compatibility for the main Page (native accessible or shim installed, verified before app load)
ENV-B2 PART 7: window.localStorage/sessionStorage are read-only Window properties (a replacement assignment never silently replaces the object; a strict-mode throw is also acceptable evidence)
Real application reaches Ready with Observation enabled
ENV-B2 PART 6: no Observation/Session/interactivePreview/ipo-shaped key appears in Storage at Ready state (Theme "dm" / Language "lang" writes are normal and allowed) — key NAMES only, never values

FIX 1/2 (ENV-B2-F2): deterministic Tab entry into the Observation radio group (Radio-group state reset through the real Clear Observation UI first, spec-aware real preceding focusable Element located and focused for setup only, exactly one real Tab press is the acceptance action, never .focus() on the radio itself, never .checked assignment)
FIX 3 (ENV-B2-F2): independent Arrow-key scenario — first Radio active after its OWN state reset + deterministic entry (never inherits the checked Radio from a previous scenario)

FIX 3 (ENV-B2-F2): all four required Arrow-key names (ArrowDown, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft) are exercised, and every expected Observation Radio ID (prefer-legacy, prefer-v2, no-visible-difference, unsure) is genuinely visited
FIX 3 (ENV-B2-F2): exactly one Radio remains checked after EVERY individual Arrow action (not only at the end)

FIX 4 (ENV-B2-F2): Observation genuinely selected via real Space activation before any Reason/Clear bound is computed (Prefer Legacy checked, exactly one Radio checked, Reason controls enabled, Clear Observation enabled)

FIX A1 (COMBINED CLOSEOUT R1): SNAPSHOT A — immediately after Observation selection, BEFORE any Reason is selected, the real focusable order is OBSERVED to be selected Radio -> Clear Observation -> every Reason control -> Clear Session, with Clear Reasons correctly DISABLED and correctly ABSENT (never a failure condition)

FIX A1 (COMBINED CLOSEOUT R1): SNAPSHOT B — after the first Reason is genuinely selected via Space, the real focusable order is OBSERVED to have Clear Reasons now ENABLED and PRESENT, appearing after every Reason control and before Clear Session

FIX A2 (COMBINED CLOSEOUT R1): every post-Reason-selection Tab bound (first Reason->Clear Reasons, Clear Reasons->Clear Session) is derived from the CURRENT post-toggle focusable order — never reusing a bound calculated while Clear Reasons was still disabled — and fails closed (never a fallback-40-as-PASS) when a bound cannot be derived
Tab exits radio group and reaches Reason checkboxes in DOM order
Space toggles a Reason checkbox
Tab reaches Clear Reasons button
Tab reaches Clear Observation button
Tab reaches Clear Session button
FIX 5 (ENV-B2-F2): Shift+Tab from the first Reason returns Focus to the EXACT previous Element (persistent identity comparison, never only an ID or tagName)
No keyboard trap after Clear Session (focus keeps advancing, proven via persistent Element identity)
Disabled sixth Reason cannot be toggled at five-Reason limit
Selected Reasons remain removable at the five-Reason limit
All interactive controls show a visible, non-zero focus indicator
Accessibility structure (fieldset/legend/native-inputs/labels/unique-IDs/accessible-names)
Main Observation status uses polite live region
